nodes.label: Receive B2B research request via POST webhook

outputs.name: research_request
outputs.description: Submitted B2B targeting criteria received via the POST webhook

requirement_evidence: The system receives B2B targeting research requests via a POST webhook
nodes.rationale: Declared webhook entry point that accepts the targeting research request.

nodes.label: Manual test run trigger

outputs.name: research_request
outputs.description: Targeting criteria supplied by a manual test run

requirement_evidence: (or manual test runs)
nodes.rationale: Declared alternative entry for manual test runs; supplies the same targeting criteria contract as the webhook.

nodes.label: Normalize targeting criteria

inputs.name: research_request
inputs.description: Raw criteria from webhook or manual run

outputs.name: normalized_criteria
outputs.description: Normalized targeting criteria including target_market, target_industries, target_roles, exclusions and score thresholds

requirement_evidence: normalizes the targeting criteria
the required criteria fields are target_market, target_industries, and target_roles
nodes.rationale: Deterministic normalization of the received criteria into a consistent shape used by all downstream steps.

nodes.label: Validate required criteria fields

inputs.name: normalized_criteria
inputs.description: Criteria whose required fields are validated

outputs.name: validation_result
outputs.description: Validity flag and any missing required fields

requirement_evidence: It validates the required fields
nodes.rationale: Deterministic presence check of the required fields (target_market, target_industries, target_roles) that produces the validity flag.

nodes.label: Check criteria validity

inputs.name: validation_result
inputs.description: Validity-flagged criteria to route

outputs.name: validation_result
outputs.description: Criteria routed to the valid or invalid branch

requirement_evidence: It validates the required fields and returns a 400 webhook response when the criteria are incomplete
nodes.rationale: Deterministic routing on the validity flag; invalid requests take the 400 rejection terminal, valid requests continue into discovery.

nodes.label: Return 400 response for incomplete criteria

inputs.name: validation_result
inputs.description: Missing-field details used to build the rejection response

requirement_evidence: returns a 400 webhook response when the criteria are incomplete
nodes.rationale: Safe rejection for incomplete criteria: returns the 400 webhook response for webhook requests; a manual run with invalid criteria simply halts. Terminal node with no outgoing CFG edge.

nodes.label: Call configurable company-discovery HTTP API

inputs.name: normalized_criteria
inputs.description: Market, industries and size filters sent to the discovery API

outputs.name: company_candidates
outputs.description: Candidate companies returned by the company-discovery API

requirement_evidence: call a configurable company-discovery HTTP API
nodes.rationale: Declared external action that discovers candidate companies from the configurable provider.

nodes.label: Remove excluded companies

inputs.name: company_candidates
inputs.description: Candidate companies to filter

inputs.name: normalized_criteria
inputs.description: Exclusion list from the criteria

outputs.name: company_candidate
outputs.description: Each non-excluded candidate company with normalized fields

requirement_evidence: remove excluded companies
nodes.rationale: Deterministic exclusion of configured companies from the candidate list; each surviving candidate is emitted individually for per-company evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluate account fit and generate evidence with language model

inputs.name: company_candidate
inputs.description: Candidate company to assess, carrying discovery data and criteria context

outputs.name: fit_evidence
outputs.description: Language-model fit assessment with evidence points and rationale

requirement_evidence: use a language model to evaluate fit and generate evidence
nodes.rationale: Open-text judgement of account fit and evidence generation; requires a language model. Company-site evidence fetching in the native graph is an implementation detail not declared in the frozen requirement and is not modelled separately.

nodes.label: Convert evidence into weighted account score

inputs.name: fit_evidence
inputs.description: Language-model fit components to weight

outputs.name: scored_account
outputs.description: Account with the deterministic weighted account score

requirement_evidence: that is converted into a weighted account score
nodes.rationale: Deterministic weighted combination of the fit components into a single account score.

nodes.label: Filter out low-scoring accounts

inputs.name: scored_account
inputs.description: Account with computed account_score and the minimum score threshold

outputs.name: scored_account
outputs.description: Account passing the minimum score threshold

requirement_evidence: filter out low-scoring accounts
nodes.rationale: Deterministic threshold filter on the weighted account score (threshold carried in the account object); low-scoring accounts are dropped and do not continue.

nodes.label: Check Airtable to avoid duplicate accounts

inputs.name: scored_account
inputs.description: Qualifying account to check against Airtable

outputs.name: account_lookup
outputs.description: Lookup result carrying the existing_account flag, record id, and the account data

requirement_evidence: check Airtable to avoid duplicates
call a configurable contact-discovery HTTP API for each qualified account
nodes.rationale: External Airtable lookup plus deterministic comparison; new accounts are created, existing accounts are reused, and both routes continue into contact discovery ('for each qualified account').

nodes.label: Create 'Qualified' account record in Airtable

inputs.name: account_lookup
inputs.description: Account data with existing_account == false

outputs.name: qualified_account
outputs.description: Newly created qualified account record with status 'Qualified'

requirement_evidence: create a 'Qualified' account record for new matches
nodes.rationale: External write persisting the qualified account record for new matches. Not terminal because processing continues into contact discovery.

nodes.label: Call configurable contact-discovery HTTP API per qualified account

inputs.name: account_lookup
inputs.description: Existing account context reused for discovery

inputs.name: qualified_account
inputs.description: Newly created qualified account used for discovery

outputs.name: contact_candidate
outputs.description: Each candidate contact returned by the configurable contact-discovery HTTP API

requirement_evidence: call a configurable contact-discovery HTTP API for each qualified account
nodes.rationale: External action discovering contacts for each qualified account (new or existing); iterates over qualified accounts (bounded by the configured account limit, at most 20 per run).

nodes.label: Score contact relevance with language model

inputs.name: contact_candidate
inputs.description: Candidate contact with title and account context

outputs.name: contact_scoring
outputs.description: Contact with language-model relevance scores and rationale

requirement_evidence: use a language model to score each contact's relevance
nodes.rationale: Open-text relevance assessment of each contact; requires a language model.

nodes.label: Filter out low-scoring or duplicate contacts using Airtable

inputs.name: contact_scoring
inputs.description: Contact with computed contact_score and the minimum score threshold

outputs.name: qualified_contact
outputs.description: Contact passing the score threshold and not duplicated in Airtable

requirement_evidence: filter out low-scoring or duplicate contacts using Airtable
nodes.rationale: Deterministic score threshold plus Airtable duplicate check; low-scoring or duplicate contacts are dropped. Persisting a separate contact record is a native implementation detail not declared as a visible outcome and is not modelled.

nodes.label: Generate evidence-based outreach brief with language model

inputs.name: qualified_contact
inputs.description: Qualified contact with account evidence and scores

outputs.name: outreach_brief
outputs.description: Evidence-based outreach brief for human review

requirement_evidence: use a language model to generate an evidence-based outreach brief
nodes.rationale: Open-text generation of a grounded outreach brief; requires a language model.

nodes.label: Create Airtable queue item with status 'Needs Human Review'

inputs.name: outreach_brief
inputs.description: Brief with evidence and scores stored in the queue item

outputs.name: queue_item
outputs.description: Airtable queue item with status 'Needs Human Review'

requirement_evidence: create an Airtable queue item with status 'Needs Human Review'
nodes.rationale: External write creating the human-review queue item. Not terminal because the compact result is still returned to the caller. Queue-level duplicate prevention is a native implementation detail not declared in the requirement.

nodes.label: Return compact JSON result for the research request

inputs.name: queue_item
inputs.description: Stored queue item used to build the compact result

requirement_evidence: return a compact JSON result for webhook requests
nodes.rationale: User-visible completion of the research lane: for webhook requests the compact JSON result is returned; manual runs simply end after the queue item is created. Terminal node with no outgoing CFG edge.

nodes.label: Daily scheduled trigger for review queue

outputs.name: run_signal
outputs.description: Daily scheduled run signal that starts the review-queue lane

requirement_evidence: the system runs daily on a schedule to load 'Needs Human Review' items
nodes.rationale: Declared daily schedule entry for the separate review-queue monitoring lane.

nodes.label: Load 'Needs Human Review' items from Airtable

inputs.name: run_signal
inputs.description: Daily run signal that starts the load

outputs.name: review_items
outputs.description: Queue items currently awaiting human review

requirement_evidence: load 'Needs Human Review' items from Airtable
nodes.rationale: External read of the pending human-review queue items for the daily lane.

nodes.label: Identify stale reviews

inputs.name: review_items
inputs.description: Pending review items to assess for staleness

outputs.name: review_summary
outputs.description: Summary of pending and stale review items

requirement_evidence: identify stale reviews
nodes.rationale: Deterministic age comparison against the staleness threshold that produces the review summary.

nodes.label: Email review summary via Gmail (optional)

inputs.name: review_summary
inputs.description: Summary emailed to the reviewer

requirement_evidence: optionally email a summary via Gmail
nodes.rationale: Optional user-visible completion of the daily lane: the summary email is sent when enabled. Terminal node with no outgoing CFG edge.

cfg_edges.rationale: Webhook requests are normalized.
Manual test runs are normalized through the same path.
Normalized criteria are validated.
The validity flag is routed.
Invalid criteria take the 400 rejection terminal.
Valid requests proceed to company discovery.
Discovered candidates are filtered for exclusions.
Eligible companies are assessed for fit.
Fit evidence is converted into a weighted score.
Scored accounts are thresholded.
Accounts meeting the threshold proceed; low-scoring accounts are dropped.
New account is created as Qualified.
Existing account is reused and continues to contact discovery.
Newly created account continues into contact discovery.
Each contact candidate is scored for relevance.
Scored contacts are filtered for score and duplicates.
Qualified contacts proceed to brief generation; low-scoring or duplicate contacts are dropped.
The brief is stored as a human-review queue item.
The compiled result is returned to the caller.
The daily run loads pending review items.
Loaded items are checked for staleness.

cfg_edges.condition: optional: the summary email is enabled
cfg_edges.rationale: The summary is emailed when the optional notification is enabled.

dfg_edges.rationale: Normalization consumes the webhook request.
Normalization consumes the manual-run criteria.
Validation consumes the normalized criteria.
The validity flag is routed.
The rejection response uses the missing-field details.
Company discovery uses the market, industries and size criteria.
Exclusion filters the discovered candidates.
Exclusion uses the exclusion list from the criteria.
Fit evaluation consumes each eligible company.
Scoring weights the fit components.
Thresholding consumes the scored account.
Duplicate checking consumes the qualifying account.
Record creation persists the new account data.
Existing account context feeds contact discovery.
New qualified account feeds contact discovery.
Relevance scoring consumes the discovered contact.
Contact filtering consumes the scored contact.
Brief generation consumes the qualified contact.
Queue item creation stores the brief.
The compact result is returned to the caller.
The daily signal starts the review-queue load.
Stale detection consumes the loaded review items.
The email carries the review summary.

notes: 共识 Gold（23 节点、两条车道）：研究车道（webhook n1 + 手动 n2 双入口 → 规范化 n3 → 校验 n4 → 分支 n5 → 400 拒绝 terminal n6 或发现链 n7→n19）＋ 每日队列车道（n20→n23）。账户/联系人按逐项单数流处理并保留'已存在账户继续联系人发现'分支（existing_account 判定）；联系人发现按 'for each qualified account' 迭代（max_iterations<=20）。混合任务类型边：n9/n15/n17(semantic)→code 由 fit_evidence/contact_scoring/outreach_brief 实现。排除未声明实现：网站证据抓取、环境配置 Set 节点、联系人记录持久化、队列级重复预防。
